Design a application that will be frame in a mobile app, must be mobile friendly and responsive. The application will be a resource that will show users about hurricane resources in their area. The application will have the following features:

1. Resource Database: The app will have a database of hurricane resources, including icon and link to the resource. The resources will be categorized by type, such as shelters, food banks, medical facilities, and emergency services.

2. Resource database will be updated regularly to ensure that users have access to the most current information.

3. system will have two web applications, one for the users and one for the admin to update the resource database.
